title: Axe pass per main route in the Playwright e2e
goal: The e2e runs axe on each main route
acceptance: `e2e/` runs axe on the eight client routes and fails on serious or critical violations; moderate ones are listed
A seeded fixture (an unlabeled input on a test-only page) proves the test fails when it should; findings on real routes are fixed here or recorded with ids
Failing test committed first: the seeded-violation fixture expects a failure before the axe pass is wired; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 3 h for the first use of the helper; the Playwright suite exists. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
